chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said, regarding a man who goes out to hunt for the distance of one day, or two days, or three: should he shorten or complete?
He said: “If he goes out for his sustenance and the sustenance of his dependents, then let him shorten and let him break his fast. But if he goes out seeking excess, then no, and no honor.”

key_terms.عِيَالِهِ: his dependents or family members under his care
key_terms.وَلْيُفْطِرْ: let him break his fast during travel
key_terms.ٱلصَّيْدِ: hunting as the purpose of travel

ai.seo_question: Does a person who travels for hunting shorten salat (prayer) and break the fast?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on travel for hunting, distinguishing between necessary livelihood and pursuit of excess. If the journey is for earning sustenance for oneself and one’s family, the traveler shortens salat (prayer) and breaks the fast; if it is merely for superfluous pursuit, that concession does not apply.
